import numpy as np
from scipy.sparse import diags, eye, kron
from scipy.sparse.linalg import splu


def calibrate_affine_banks(
    raw_observations: np.ndarray, observation_banks: np.ndarray,
    reference_levels: np.ndarray, sweep_readouts: np.ndarray,
    sweep_banks: np.ndarray, *, prior: np.ndarray | None = None,
    three_point_rtol: float = 1e-6,
) -> np.ndarray:
    """Invert raw = gain * reference + offset independently by bank.

    Supply 1-D arrays and nonnegative integer bank IDs. Prior rows contain
    (gain, offset) in the current measurement units, with positive gain;
    the default is (1, 0). No continuous gain penalty is applied. Three
    sweeps above the relative residual gate use a prior-ranked positive pair
    fit; the prior is a tie-breaker between plausible fits, not evidence
    that the bank is unchanged. From four sweeps onward, screen at 4.5
    robust scales and refit. With unresolved levels retain the prior gain;
    use the median residual for the offset if any sweeps are available.
    """
    raw = np.asarray(raw_observations, dtype=float)
    banks = np.asarray(observation_banks)
    refs = np.asarray(reference_levels, dtype=float)
    reads = np.asarray(sweep_readouts, dtype=float)
    sweep_ids = np.asarray(sweep_banks)
    priors = None if prior is None else np.asarray(prior, dtype=float)
    calibrated = np.empty_like(raw)
    for bank in np.unique(banks):
        rows = banks == bank
        sel = sweep_ids == bank
        x, y = refs[sel], reads[sel]
        g0, b0 = (1.0, 0.0) if priors is None else priors[bank]
        if not (np.isfinite(g0) and g0 > 0):
            raise ValueError('Prior gains must be finite and positive')
        gain = g0
        offset = float(np.median(y - g0 * x)) if x.size else b0
        if x.size >= 2:
            span = np.ptp(x)
            if span > 1e-12 * np.max(np.abs(x)):
                u = (x - x.mean()) / span
                v = y - y.mean()
                slope = float((u @ v) / (u @ u))
                y_span = np.ptp(y)
                ambiguous = (x.size == 3 and
                             np.max(np.abs(v - slope * u)) > three_point_rtol * y_span)
                if ambiguous or x.size >= 4:
                    i, j = np.triu_indices(x.size, 1)
                    du = u[j] - u[i]
                    distinct = np.abs(du) > 1e-12
                    i, j, du = i[distinct], j[distinct], du[distinct]
                    slopes = (v[j] - v[i]) / du
                    positive = slopes > 0
                    i, slopes = i[positive], slopes[positive]
                if ambiguous:
                    if slopes.size:
                        gains = slopes / span
                        offsets = y[i] - gains * x[i]
                        distance = np.hypot(np.log(gains / g0), (offsets - b0) / (span * g0))
                        best = int(np.argmin(distance))
                        gain, offset = gains[best], offsets[best]
                else:
                    keep = np.ones(x.size, dtype=bool)
                    if x.size >= 4 and slopes.size:
                        residuals = v[None, :] - slopes[:, None] * u[None, :]
                        errors = np.abs(residuals - np.median(residuals, axis=1)[:, None])
                        scores = np.median(errors, axis=1)
                        best = int(np.argmin(scores))
                        scale = max(1.4826 * scores[best], 1e-12 * y_span)
                        inliers = errors[best] <= 4.5 * scale
                        if np.count_nonzero(inliers) >= 2 and np.ptp(u[inliers]) > 1e-12:
                            keep = inliers
                    uc = u[keep] - u[keep].mean()
                    vc = v[keep] - v[keep].mean()
                    fitted = float((uc @ vc) / (uc @ uc) / span)
                    if fitted > 0:
                        gain = fitted
                        offset = float(y[keep].mean() - gain * x[keep].mean())
        calibrated[rows] = (raw[rows] - offset) / gain
    return calibrated


def separable_transport_design(
    lengths: tuple[float, float], diffusivities: tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray],
    velocities: tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray], robin: tuple[float, float],
    baseline_reactions: tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray], reaction_field: np.ndarray,
    source_modes: np.ndarray, shifts: np.ndarray, sensor_indices: np.ndarray,
    *, separability_rtol: float = 1e-10,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Solve shifted steady transport on a uniform cell-centered rectangle.

    Use harmonic diffusion, row-wise upwinding of velocity times gradient
    (zero exterior advective inflow), and one Robin transfer rate per axis
    shared by its two ends. Diffusivity is L²/T; velocity and transfer are
    L/T; reactions and shifts are 1/T. Each spacing is an axis-length
    fraction. Require invertible shifted operators; add no forward ridge.
    The separable extra reaction supplements the baseline axis reactions.
    Input modes have shape (M,nx,ny), sensor indices have shape (N,2).
    Return shift-first sensor rows and the last-shift modes (nx,ny,M).
    """
    field_reaction = np.asarray(reaction_field, dtype=float)
    modes = np.asarray(source_modes, dtype=float)
    shifts = np.asarray(shifts, dtype=float)
    nx, ny = field_reaction.shape
    if min(nx, ny) < 1 or modes.ndim != 3 or modes.shape[1:] != (nx, ny) or not shifts.size:
        raise ValueError('Supply nonempty axes, grid-shaped source modes and at least one shift')
    rx = field_reaction.mean(axis=1)
    ry = field_reaction.mean(axis=0) - field_reaction.mean()
    defect = field_reaction - (rx[:, None] + ry[None, :])
    if np.max(np.abs(defect)) > separability_rtol * np.max(np.abs(field_reaction)):
        raise ValueError('The added reaction is not separable at the requested tolerance')
    operators = []
    for axis, (n, extra) in enumerate(((nx, rx), (ny, ry))):
        length = lengths[axis]
        k = np.asarray(diffusivities[axis], dtype=float)
        v = np.asarray(velocities[axis], dtype=float)
        base = np.asarray(baseline_reactions[axis], dtype=float)
        transfer = robin[axis]
        if k.shape != (n,) or v.shape != (n,) or base.shape != (n,):
            raise ValueError('Axis coefficients must have one value per cell')
        if length <= 0 or np.any(k <= 0) or transfer < 0:
            raise ValueError('Require positive lengths and diffusivities and nonnegative transfer')
        h = 1.0 / n
        k, v, transfer = k / length**2, v / length, transfer / length
        p = np.maximum(v, 0.0) / h
        m = np.maximum(-v, 0.0) / h
        q = 2 * k[:-1] * k[1:] / (k[:-1] + k[1:]) / h**2
        diagonal = base + extra + p + m
        diagonal[:-1] += q
        diagonal[1:] += q
        ends = np.array([0, n - 1])
        np.add.at(diagonal, ends, transfer * k[ends] / (h * (transfer * h / 2 + k[ends])))
        if n == 1:
            operators.append(diags([diagonal], [0], format='csc'))
        else:
            operators.append(diags((-q - p[1:], diagonal, -q - m[:-1]), (-1, 0, 1), format='csc'))
    ax, ay = operators
    op = (kron(ax, eye(ny)) + kron(eye(nx), ay)).tocsc()
    identity = eye(nx * ny, format='csc')
    rhs = modes.reshape(modes.shape[0], nx * ny).T
    i, j = np.asarray(sensor_indices).T
    rows = []
    for shift in shifts:
        terminal = splu(op + shift * identity).solve(rhs).reshape(nx, ny, modes.shape[0])
        rows.append(terminal[i, j])
    return np.concatenate(rows, axis=0), terminal


def fit_box_simplex(
    design: np.ndarray, observations: np.ndarray, nuisance: np.ndarray,
    *, cap: float, budget: float, source_ridge: float, nuisance_ridge: float = 0.0,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, dict[str, float | np.ndarray]]:
    """Minimize half the squared directly residualized error plus source ridge.

    Weights are in [0, cap] with fixed sum budget. Apply I minus the nuisance
    ridge hat matrix to both observations and design, not its square root.
    Zero nuisance ridge is ordinary orthogonal projection off nuisance;
    pass (n_rows, 0) for no nuisance. The strictly positive source ridge
    gives uniqueness. Ridges are in squared column units of their matrices.
    The sum multiplier uses g - nu - lower + upper = 0; the reported
    lower bound comes from minimizing the objective's tangent on the slice.
    """
    D = np.asarray(design, dtype=float)
    y = np.asarray(observations, dtype=float)
    Z = np.asarray(nuisance, dtype=float)
    if D.ndim != 2 or y.shape != (D.shape[0],) or Z.ndim != 2 or Z.shape[0] != D.shape[0]:
        raise ValueError('Design, observations and nuisance must share rows')
    n = D.shape[1]
    if n == 0 or cap <= 0 or not 0 <= budget <= n * cap:
        raise ValueError('Infeasible box-simplex constraint')
    if source_ridge <= 0 or nuisance_ridge < 0:
        raise ValueError('Require positive source ridge and nonnegative nuisance ridge')
    data = np.column_stack((D, y))
    if Z.shape[1]:
        if nuisance_ridge == 0:
            data -= Z @ np.linalg.lstsq(Z, data, rcond=None)[0]
        else:
            U, s, _ = np.linalg.svd(Z, full_matrices=False)
            shrink = s**2 / (s**2 + nuisance_ridge)
            data -= U @ (shrink[:, None] * (U.T @ data))
    S, r = data[:, :-1], data[:, -1]
    A = S * cap
    H = A.T @ A + source_ridge * cap**2 * np.eye(n)
    c = -(A.T @ r)
    scale = max(np.max(np.abs(H)), np.max(np.abs(c)))
    H, c = H / scale, c / scale
    if budget == 0:
        x, nu = np.zeros(n), float(np.min(c))
    elif budget == n * cap:
        x = np.ones(n)
        nu = float(np.max(H @ x + c))
    else:
        x = np.full(n, budget / (n * cap))
        state = np.zeros(n, dtype=int)
        for _ in range(100 * n):
            g = H @ x + c
            free = np.flatnonzero(state == 0)
            if free.size == 0:
                lo = int(np.argmin(np.where(state < 0, g, np.inf)))
                hi = int(np.argmax(np.where(state > 0, g, -np.inf)))
                if g[hi] - g[lo] <= 1e-12:
                    nu = float((g[hi] + g[lo]) / 2)
                    break
                state[[lo, hi]] = 0
                continue
            block = H[np.ix_(free, free)]
            a, b = np.linalg.solve(block, np.column_stack((g[free], np.ones(free.size)))).T
            nu = float(a.sum() / b.sum())
            step = nu * b - a
            alpha = np.full(free.size, np.inf)
            np.divide(1 - x[free], step, out=alpha, where=step > 1e-14)
            np.divide(-x[free], step, out=alpha, where=step < -1e-14)
            hit = int(np.argmin(alpha))
            if alpha[hit] < 1:
                x[free] += max(0.0, alpha[hit]) * step
                state[free[hit]] = 1 if step[hit] > 0 else -1
                x[free[hit]] = float(state[free[hit]] > 0)
                continue
            x[free] += step
            violation = state * (H @ x + c - nu)
            release = int(np.argmax(violation))
            if violation[release] <= 1e-12:
                break
            state[release] = 0
        else:
            raise RuntimeError('Box-simplex active set did not converge')
    w = cap * np.clip(x, 0, 1)
    nu_sum = float(nu * scale / cap)
    residual = S @ w - r
    g = S.T @ residual + source_ridge * w
    lower = np.maximum(g - nu_sum, 0)
    upper = np.maximum(nu_sum - g, 0)
    primal = float(0.5 * (residual @ residual + source_ridge * (w @ w)))
    bound = primal + nu_sum * (budget - w.sum()) - lower @ w - upper @ (cap - w)
    return w, {'weights': w.copy(), 'nu_sum': nu_sum, 'lam_lower': lower,
               'lam_upper': upper, 'primal_objective': primal, 'dual_lower_bound': float(bound)}

def run_self_test():
    lengths = (2., 4.)
    k = (np.array([1., 3.]), np.array([2., 6.]))

    shifts = np.array([.2, .8])

    # Independent physical-space stencils with heterogeneous diffusion and Robin transfer.
    Ax = np.array([[1.5 + .4 + .4 + .2 + .1, -1.9],
                   [-1.7, 1.5 + .2 + 6/13 + .6 + .3]])
    Ay = np.array([[.75 + .3 + 1/6 + .4 - .05, -.75],
                   [-.85, .75 + .1 + .1875 + .1 + .05]])
    truth = np.array([[[1., 0., 0.], [0., 2., 0.]], [[0., 0., 3.], [1., -1., .5]]])

    op = np.kron(Ax, np.eye(2)) + np.kron(np.eye(2), Ay)
    first = np.linalg.solve(op + shifts[0] * np.eye(4), modes.reshape(3, 4).T).reshape(2, 2, 3)
    i, j = sensors.T
    np.testing.assert_allclose(terminal, truth, atol=2e-12)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(design, np.vstack((first[i, j], truth[i, j])), atol=2e-12)

    length_scale, rate = .01, 2.
    perm = np.array([2, 0, 3, 1])

        tuple(length_scale*a for a in lengths[::-1]),

        tuple(length_scale*rate*a for a in robin[::-1]),

    # Prescribe a KKT solution with a lower bound, a free weight and an upper bound.
    wt = np.array([0., .4, .6])
    g = np.array([.3, .1, -.2])

    Z = np.zeros((len(design), 1))
    Z[0, 0] = 1
    d = np.ones(len(design))
    d[0] = .5  # Unit nuisance ridge gives this direct residual multiplier.
    err = np.linalg.lstsq(design.T * d**2, g - ridge*wt, rcond=None)[0]
    y = design @ wt - err
    gains = np.array([1.6, 1.18, .75, 1.2])
    offsets = np.array([.2, .23, -.1, .3])
    reference = np.array([-2., -1., 0., 1., 2., -1., 0., 2., .5])
    sweep_banks = np.array([0]*5 + [1]*3 + [2])
    clean_reads = gains[sweep_banks]*reference + offsets[sweep_banks]
    banks = np.array([0, 1, 2, 3, 1, 0, 3, 2])
    raw = gains[banks]*y + offsets[banks]
    prior = np.array([[1., 0.], [1.16, .21], [.75, .5], [1.2, .3]])
    signal = 1e-3
    scaled_prior = prior.copy()
    scaled_prior[:, 1] *= signal
    for spike in (-2., 2.):
        reads = clean_reads.copy()
        reads[2] += 25.
        reads[6] += spike
        calibrated = calibrate_affine_banks(raw, banks, reference, reads, sweep_banks, prior=prior)
        scaled_calibrated = calibrate_affine_banks(
            signal*raw[row_perm], banks[row_perm], signal*reference[::-1],
            signal*reads[::-1], sweep_banks[::-1], prior=scaled_prior)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(calibrated, y, atol=2e-12)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(scaled_calibrated, signal*y[row_perm], atol=2e-14)

    x3 = np.array([-1., 0., 2.])
    shifted = calibrate_affine_banks(np.array([.7*3 - .5]), np.array([0]), x3,
        .7*x3 - .5, np.zeros(3, dtype=int), prior=np.array([[1.16, .21]]))
    np.testing.assert_allclose(shifted, [3.], atol=2e-12)

    np.testing.assert_allclose(w.sum(), 1., atol=2e-12)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(terminal @ w, truth @ wt, atol=2e-11)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(cert['nu_sum'], .1, atol=2e-11)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(cert['lam_lower'], [.2, 0., 0.], atol=2e-11)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(cert['lam_upper'], [0., 0., .3], atol=2e-11)
    objective = .5 * (np.linalg.norm(d*err)**2 + ridge*(wt @ wt))
    np.testing.assert_allclose(cert['primal_objective'], objective, atol=2e-12)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(cert['dual_lower_bound'], objective, atol=2e-12)
    sw, sc = fit_box_simplex(signal*sd, scaled_calibrated, Z[row_perm], cap=.6,
                            budget=1., source_ridge=ridge*signal**2, nuisance_ridge=1.)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(sw, wt, atol=2e-11)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(sc['dual_lower_bound'] / signal**2, objective, atol=2e-12)
    for fill in (0., .6):

                                   source_ridge=ridge, nuisance_ridge=1.)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(edge, np.full(3, fill), atol=2e-12)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(ec['dual_lower_bound'], ec['primal_objective'], atol=2e-12)
        assert all(np.isfinite(value).all() for value in ec.values())
    for array in (design, terminal, sd, sf, calibrated, scaled_calibrated, w, sw):
        assert np.isfinite(array).all()
    assert all(np.isfinite(value).all() for value in cert.values())
    assert all(np.isfinite(value).all() for value in sc.values())


run_self_test()
